title: 第11章 魔法历史课第12章 贵族遍地是亲戚
content_zh:
今天就这魔法师冥想启蒙一门课，上完课的默里去食堂吃过午餐，就回到宿舍楼，盘坐在床上，尝试独自冥想。
这个世界战士修炼战气，魔法师修炼魔力；而冥想就是修炼魔力的必要手段。
魔法师通过冥想，集中精力，提升精神力量，让精神力量来捕捉游历于天地之间的魔法粒子，把它们拉入体内，与精神力量相结合，诞生魔力。
理论成立，开始实践。
盘坐在床上的默里不断默念冥想口诀，按照林登·比尔的引导，开始运行冥想法，但是他默念了三遍冥想法，都没有出现课堂上的那种兴奋感。
至于所谓的精神力量，他是一点都没感觉到，没过多久，感到有些疲惫的默里，身体往后一倒，躺在床上，盖好被子呼呼大睡起来。
可就在他睡着没多久，一颗肉眼无法看到的灰色粒子凭空出现，缓缓飘入默里的脑袋。
此时，默里正在做一个奇怪的梦，他梦到自己被一辆货车撞飞，五米，十米，二十米，五十米...上万米，飞上了天，穿过云层，冲出了大气层。
并且他还在不停的飞，地球都在他眼前不断变小，直至消失，路过一片灰蒙蒙的地方，他全身仿佛被刷了一层灰漆，整个人也变成灰蒙蒙的，但是他还是没有停下，一直飞。
双腿猛地一蹬，一股踩空感袭来，默里·格林立即从睡梦中惊醒。
“淦，做噩梦了。”
看着周围熟悉的家具，清醒过来的默里意识到自己做了个噩梦，仔细回想一下，却发现自己根本没有记住噩梦的内容，只知道自己一直在飞，还有浓浓的灰色。
打着哈欠从床上爬起，伸了伸懒腰，活动了下筋骨，默里·格林发现这一觉睡得不错，精神充沛，一点都不像平时睡不醒的样子，不过他也没有在意。
看向窗外，日落西山。
“这个午觉睡得真久，一觉醒来，天都黑了。”
……
魔法师冥想启蒙课、魔法历史、魔法动植物基础认识、魔法物品鉴赏、魔法礼仪与咒语，这是基础课程表上的五门课，每天一门，一周五门，都安排在上午，周六周天休息。
“魔法的历史源远流长，万年以前，人们就开始接触并使用魔法，只不过当时的魔法不成系统，极其混乱。”
这一节课不同于只有二十个学生的冥想课，而是一堂大课，上百号学生一起坐在一个大教室里上课。
一个白发苍苍的老魔法老师正在讲台上滔滔不绝，表情亢奋的讲解着魔法的发展历史。

这门课程，默里·格林很感兴趣，毕竟这个世界不同于上个世界，许多知识上网一搜，正版，改版，魔改版，听读版等等，各种版本应有尽有。
这个世界的知识是十分昂贵的，尤其是魔法知识，每一份知识都有属于它的价格，所以这个世界，很多知识都是垄断性的。
因此，魔法历史这堂课同样没有教材，所有内容都是老师口述，允许学生记笔记，但不要外传内容，不然学院将有权对外泄知识的学生进行惩罚。
“现在的魔法历史研究者，按照魔法的发展进程，将魔法发展史分为三个时间段，第一个时间段就是远古的血魔法时代，时间大概在一万年前。”
“第二个是上古混乱魔法时代，时间在一万年前到神启历元年，最后就是现在的元素魔法时代，现在我要讲解的是远古血魔法时代。”
content_en:
Today is the magician's meditation enlightenment class. After the class, Murray went to the cafeteria to have lunch, then returned to the dormitory building, sat cross-legged on the bed, and tried to meditate alone.
In this world, warriors cultivate fighting spirit and magicians cultivate magic power; meditation is a necessary means to cultivate magic power.
Through meditation, the magician concentrates and improves his mental power, allowing his mental power to capture the magic particles traveling between heaven and earth, pulling them into the body, and combining them with the mental power to create magic power.
The theory is established and practice begins.
Murray, who was sitting cross-legged on the bed, kept reciting the meditation mantra silently, and started to run the meditation method according to Lyndon Beale's guidance. However, he recited the meditation method silently three times, but he did not feel the same excitement as in the class.
As for the so-called spiritual power, he didn't feel it at all. Not long after, Murray, who felt a little tired, fell back, lay on the bed, covered himself with a quilt and fell asleep.
But not long after he fell asleep, a gray particle invisible to the naked eye appeared out of thin air and slowly floated into Murray's head.
At this time, Murray was having a strange dream. He dreamed that he was hit by a truck and flew five meters, ten meters, twenty meters, fifty meters... tens of thousands of meters, flying into the sky, passing through the clouds, and rushing out of the atmosphere.
And he kept flying, the earth kept getting smaller before his eyes, until it disappeared. Passing by a gray place, his whole body seemed to be painted with a layer of gray paint, and his whole body became gray, but he still did not stop and kept flying.
His legs kicked hard, and a feeling of stepping on the air came over him, and Murray Green immediately woke up from his sleep.
"Gan, I have a nightmare."
Looking at the familiar furniture around him, Murray woke up and realized that he had had a nightmare. When he thought about it carefully, he found that he did not remember the content of the nightmare at all. He only knew that he had been flying and it was thick gray.
Yawning, he got up from the bed, stretched, and stretched his muscles. Murray Green found that he had a good sleep and was full of energy. He was not at all like his usual sleepless self, but he didn't care.
Looking out the window, the sun sets.
"I took a really long nap this afternoon. When I woke up, it was already dark."
…
Magician Meditation Enlightenment Course, History of Magic, Basic Understanding of Magical Animals and Plants, Appreciation of Magical Items, Magical Etiquette and Spells, these are the five courses on the basic course schedule, one per day, five per week, all scheduled in the morning, with rest on Saturdays and Sundays.
"Magic has a long history. People began to come into contact with and use magic thousands of years ago, but the magic at that time was unsystematic and extremely chaotic."
This class is different from a meditation class with only twenty students, but a large class with hundreds of students sitting together in a large classroom.
A gray-haired old magic teacher was talking non-stop on the podium, explaining the history of the development of magic with an excited expression.
Murray Green is very interested in this course. After all, this world is different from the previous one. A lot of knowledge can be found online by searching the original version, modified version, magic modified version, audio-reading version, etc., all kinds of versions are available.
Knowledge in this world is very expensive, especially magic knowledge. Every piece of knowledge has its own price, so in this world, a lot of knowledge is monopolized.
Therefore, the History of Magic class also has no teaching materials. All the content is dictated by the teacher. Students are allowed to take notes, but they are not allowed to share the content. Otherwise, the college will have the right to punish students who leak knowledge.
"Current magic history researchers divide the history of magic into three time periods according to the development process of magic. The first time period is the ancient blood magic era, which happened about 10,000 years ago."
"The second is the ancient era of chaotic magic, which lasted from 10,000 years ago to the first year of the Divine Enlightenment Calendar. The last is the current era of elemental magic. What I want to explain now is the ancient era of blood magic."
